# Project Context
Building a landing page for "NANO" - a workshop and catalog business.

# Skills
- React (Vite)
- TailwindCSS

# Rules
- Use functional components only.
- Language: Hebrew (RTL). 
- Always add `dir="rtl"` and `lang="he"` to the main wrapper.
- Use Tailwind logical properties (e.g., `pe-4` instead of `pr-4`) for RTL compatibility.
- Design: Modern, clean, mobile-first.
- Theme: Match colors to the logo found at `src/assets/logo.svg`.
